entities.summary: The Basilica and Monastery of St. Benedict Is an important Catholic architectural complex built in Baroque style located in Olinda, Pernambuco, Brazil, which together with much of the historic center of the city, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Benedict, Olinda is a church building in Americas. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
